headline: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq fall as chip stocks tumble, oil surges on US-Iran tensions
summary: The Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq fell as chip stocks tumbled and oil surged amid US-Iran tensions. Markets were subdued ahead of inflation reports and bank earnings.
why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq are the main US equity benchmarks, and chipmakers carry heavy weight in them, so sector moves shape index performance.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The benchmark index fell as chip stocks tumbled and geopolitical risk rose.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Chip stocks fell sharply while oil rose on renewed US-Iran tensions, pressuring the major US indexes ahead of key inflation and bank earnings data.
